description: This file contains automated test scripts for the 'git p4' integration, testing error handling, authentication, and subprocess execution related to Perforce (p4) commands within a Git context.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce version control.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 login
methods.description: Logs into the Perforce server with provided credentials.

methods.name: p4 logout
methods.description: Logs out from the Perforce server.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a label and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands expecting failure, captures error messages.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with a specified message.
